item.title: Nathan Lane Returns to Broadway: Death of a Salesman Revival Sells Out Previews
item.description:
Nathan Lane’s Triumphant Return to Broadway

Nathan Lane is once again commanding the stage, and audiences can’t get enough. The Tony Award-winning actor’s latest Broadway venture — a revival of Arthur Miller’s Death of a Salesman — has sold out its preview performances at the Winter Garden Theatre, with the official opening night now set for April 9, 2026.

Key Takeaways:

  • Nathan Lane and Laurie Metcalf star as Willy and Linda Loman
  • Previews began March 6 and sold out immediately
  • The production runs through June 14, 2026
  • Directed by Tony winner Joe Mantello
  • Features an original score by Pulitzer Prize winner Caroline Shaw

A Powerhouse Cast Brings Miller’s Masterpiece to Life

Lane and Laurie Metcalf, both Tony winners in their own right, lead the cast as Willy and Linda Loman. The supporting ensemble is equally impressive, featuring Christopher Abbott, Ben Ahlers, K. Todd Freeman, Jonathan Cake, John Drea, Michael Benjamin Washington, Tasha Lawrence, and Jake Silbermann.

item.title: NYT Strands #739 Answers: 'Out-and-Out' Puzzle Hints, Spangram, and Solutions (March 12, 2026)
item.description:
If you have been staring at today’s Strands grid for twenty minutes and the phrase “Out-and-Out” still means nothing to you, you are not alone. Puzzle #739 is one of those grids where the theme clicks all at once — or not at all. The moment you realize what connects the hidden words, every answer falls into place like dominoes.

Key Takeaways

  • NYT Strands #739 (March 12, 2026) has the theme “Out-and-Out”
  • The spangram is DYEDINTHEWOOL — a 13-letter, 4-word phrase running diagonally across the grid
  • The 5 theme words are: TOTAL, UTTER, THOROUGH, COMPLETE, VERITABLE
  • All 6 answers (5 theme words + 1 spangram) use every single letter in the 6x8 grid
  • The theme connects words that mean “absolute” or “without question”

item.title: Super Mario Bros Nintendo Switch: The Ultimate Guide to Every Game Worth Playing
item.description:
Super Mario Bros Nintendo Switch: The Ultimate Guide to Every Game Worth Playing

Did you know that the Super Mario franchise has sold over 800 million copies worldwide, making it the best-selling video game franchise in history? And yet, many Nintendo Switch owners have played fewer than half of the Mario titles available on the platform. If you own a Switch, you are sitting on one of the richest libraries of Super Mario Bros content ever assembled on a single console.

item.title: Stephen Moyer's Remarkable Career Revival: From True Blood to The Night Agent & The Forsytes
item.description:
Did you know Stephen Moyer just made history — twice in one month? The British actor, best known as Bill Compton from True Blood, is simultaneously making waves on two major platforms in early 2026, and the story behind it is genuinely remarkable for any fan of quality television.

Quick Summary

  • Stephen Moyer joins The Night Agent Season 3 as Peter Sutherland’s most dangerous adversary yet
  • His new PBS drama The Forsytes was renewed for Seasons 2 AND 3 before Season 1 even aired — a first in his 35-year career
  • The Forsytes premieres March 22, 2026 on PBS Masterpiece; all 6 episodes drop simultaneously on the PBS app
  • Moyer plays Jolyon Forsyte Sr., a wealthy Victorian-era stockbroker and family patriarch

Stephen Moyer in The Night Agent Season 3: A “Prodigious Adversary”

Netflix’s action thriller The Night Agent dropped its third season in early March 2026, and Stephen Moyer is one of its most talked-about new additions.
